item.title: Former rowing champion’s Olympic gold medal stolen in home burglary
item.description: Les O'Connell won the medal at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, rowing in the men's coxless four, and was appealing to whoever pinched it to give it back undamaged.

item.title: Police criminal probe into Pike River nearly finished
item.description: Police are nearing the final stages of their criminal investigation into the Pike River mine disaster, in which 29 men were killed.

item.title: Ousted Te Pāti Māori MP holds on to her job - for now
item.description: Mariameno Kapa-Kingi will have to wait for the results of the judicial review of her expulsion.

item.title: Seven injured in crash involving pedestrians in Whangaparāoa Peninsula
item.description: Whangaparaoa Road closed as emergency services respond to two-vehicle crash.

item.title: Kiwi couple who managed Epstein ranch also worked at his notorious island, documents show
item.description: The pair were initially brought on to manage the Zorro Ranch, but their culinary skills soon saw them replace Epstein’s personal chef.

item.title: Australian snowboarder killed after being suspended from ski lift in Japan
item.description: Japanese media have identified Ella Day Brooke, 22, as the snowboarder who died after being suspended from a ski lift at a resort.

item.title: ‘Upsetting and demoralising’ act of vandalism at north Auckland school
item.description: The principal of a school in north Auckland says an act of vandalism over the weekend has caused tens of thousands of dollars worth of damage.

item.title: More interest rates relief coming for homeowners
item.description: Interest rates might have started to rise but what home loan borrowers pay in interest is likely to keep falling through this year.

item.title: CCTV shows man knocked out after mate throws chair outside Melbourne strip club
item.description: Videos have captured the moment a man was knocked out by a chair thrown by his own friend outside a strip club in Melbourne.

item.title: Christchurch to drop from max 15c temp 'well before dawn' on bitterly cold Tuesday
item.description: A Heavy Rain Watch is in place for Christchurch, with significant rain due overnight and into Tuesday.
